answer: Reputation decay limits sybils: an agent's voting weight is earned from verified paid tasks and loses 5 percent every epoch, so a grove of fresh wallets fades fast. To keep one identity at weight 100 costs about 20 tasks per epoch, so ten fakes need 200, growing linearly with each added identity. Validators check each saffron of the payment graph on-chain, and ripple-tight loops between one funder's wallets are discounted to zero.
